🗣️ The mother daughter duo @TinyMajorMama & @Zonnique will be live on The Breakfast Club to promote Tiny's upcoming 'Uncensored' episode on @tvonetv at Thursday at 8p/7c . Set your alarms ⏰ and Listen live Tomorrow ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

Donkey of the Day goes to a lawyer who stole $4.4M in COVID funds to wine and dine his the GF, then got emotional while being sentenced to 6 years. SMH 😒 Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨 @claressashields speaks out about her beef with Laila Ali and claims she was right about her: “She’s a hater!”. Check out the full interview on @netflix !

Video

🚨 "People lying on your cat… is just foul!” @claressashields opens up about how she felt after 50 Cent came at her and Papoose on a random day in 2026. Check out the full interview on @netflix !

Video

🚨 @claressashields hopped out of the ring for a hot second and jumped into the booth to make a song for her man, Papoose but what made her do it???

Video

Jay-Z, in a recent interview with GQ, dives into his feelings about the attacks he has endured over the years, his thoughts on the rap battle between Drake & Kendrick, and whether rap battling needs to be a part of the culture. Tap in 🔊

Video

✈️ Air traffic audio has been released following the fatal collision at LaGuardia Airport, where you can clearly hear someone say, “I messed up.” Tap in as @mimibrowntv breaks down how only one air traffic controller was working at the time of the crash. Catch it on Front Page News.

Video

🤔 Julez, “Solange’s son,” was seen out with Tommie Lee which is a 20+ year age difference , and it sent the internet into a frenzy! Would you condone your son dating a woman 20+ years older? Let's discuss ⬇️

Video

🚨 @YungMiami305  switched ‘ Out of Context‘ to @CareshaPlease  right after the cameras stopped rolling and posed the question to @cthagod  Unc: Do you believe people can change? Check out the full conversation on @youtube RN 📺

Video

Nia Long has an alleged stalker and is filing for a restraining order for protection after a woman showed up to her home on multiple occasions. Tap into the lates w/ @LorenLorosa

Video

🚨 The separation of the “City Girls” was hard for the fans, but what caused the breakdown and could there a future where both JT & @yungmiami305 will come back together to bring back that Miami sound? Check out the full interview on YouTube!

Video

🚨Full interview w/ @YungMiami305 & @cthagod out now!
➡️ piped.video/rn7hBym44Kc?si=-DkZ…

In an “Out of Context” interview @cthagod sat down w/ @yungmiami305 and explains why she continued to support Diddy, even though it impacted her negatively. “I can’t turn my back on someone that easily.” Full interview out at 8:30 AM on @YouTube!

Video

🚨 Congratulations 🎊🍾 are in order because after the announcement 📣 that Jaÿ-Z is planning his anniversary shows at Yankee Stadium, 1.6 million people lined up to purchase tickets! The first round of tickets are sold out, but the second round will be available today, and @lorenlorosa has the latest.

Video

🚨 @TheRealDrUmar breaks down what happened between him and his estranged daughter who took to social media with claims he hasn’t  been in her life. “every time I try to meet ti see my daughter she never shows up” ➡️ Check out the full interview on @netflix RN!

Video

🚨 As of today, President Trump is deploying ICE agents to airports nationwide to assist during the TSA shortage amid the government shutdown. @mimibrowntv breaks it down during Front Page News, and The Breakfast Club weighs in on the decision.

Video

Donkey of the Day goes to Donald Trump for his comments on former FBI Director Robert Mueller’s death, claiming he’s glad he’s dead 😳 Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨 @drumarjohnson makes it clear: he is not the “pappy” of that dere baby,  and supports her as a brother but declares that he’s not taken, she may be the one to produce his heir…👀

Video

🚨 @TheRealDrUmar  gives updates on the status of his 'Frederick Douglass Marcus Garvey Academy' and what has delayed the school’s opening to August 2027. ➡️ Check out the full conversation on @breakfastclubam on @netflix.
